subject: E-5218: TLS handshake failed on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using CourierOS 3.5.3 on Windows 11 24H2. Since the weekend, every time
I open the app, I get 'E-5218: TLS handshake failed'.

The system clock is wrong after a motherboard battery failure. The login page in
the browser also shows a certificate warning.

I've already tried searching the help centre, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Grace Okafor (Northbank Studio)
